# PRD to Issues

Read `prd/PRD.md` and break it into independently grabbable issues using
**vertical slices** (tracer bullets). Avoid horizontal layers — do not do
"all DB, then all API, then all frontend".

Each issue must be a thin slice of functionality that crosses all layers
(DB, API, frontend) so the team gets instant feedback loops.

Save one issue per markdown file in the `issues/` directory, named
`NNN-short-slug.md` where `NNN` is a zero-padded priority number.
Each issue should contain:
- Title
- Priority tier (Infrastructure / Tracer Bullet / Polishing)
- Acceptance criteria
- Dependencies on other issues

Acceptance criteria must be **diff-verifiable**: provable from the repository
plus that issue diff alone at review time (code, tests, files, observable
behavior). Never write criteria about artifacts that exist only after the run —
the pull request or its description, release notes, deployments, demos, or
human sign-off. Leave PRD process expectations (e.g. a "Hand-off notes"
section) out of the issue files entirely: the QA gate cannot verify them per
issue, and the developer agent is not allowed to edit issue files to satisfy
them, so such criteria deadlock the QA loop.

Before finishing, lint every issue file: re-read each acceptance criterion and
rewrite or drop any that a reviewer holding only the repository and that issue
diff could not verify.
